# docker_volume (Resource)

A Docker volume (`VolumeCreate`). Volumes cannot be changed after creation, so every argument except `cluster_volume_spec.availability` forces a new volume (and its data is lost). Destroy fails while a container still uses the volume. Import by volume name. Swarm cluster (CSI) volumes are created with `cluster_volume_spec` (their `availability` updates in place). The raw `inspect_json` output is sensitive because driver options can hold credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "docker_volume" "data" {
  name   = "app-data"
  labels = { team = "web" }
}

# A local volume backed by an NFS export.
resource "docker_volume" "nfs" {
  name   = "shared"
  driver = "local"
  driver_opts = {
    type   = "nfs"
    o      = "addr=10.0.0.10,rw,nfsvers=4"
    device = ":/export/shared"
  }
}

# A Swarm cluster (CSI) volume: the provider must point at a swarm manager
# and the CSI plugin must be installed on the nodes. Only availability
# changes in place.
resource "docker_volume" "csi" {
  name   = "db-data"
  driver = "csi-driver-nfs"
  cluster_volume_spec = {
    group        = "db"
    availability = "active"
    access_mode = {
      scope   = "single"
      sharing = "none"
      mount_volume = {
        fs_type = "ext4"
      }
    }
    capacity_range = {
      required_bytes = 10737418240
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `adopt` (Boolean) Take over an object whose `io.terraform.provider.owner` label names a different owner than the provider's `owner` argument (for example after `terraform import`). Without it, planning such an object fails. Only checked when the provider sets `owner`. Default `false`.
- `cluster_volume_spec` (Attributes) Swarm cluster (CSI) volume specification (`ClusterVolumeSpec`, API 1.42+); setting it creates a cluster volume through the Swarm manager instead of a local volume, so the provider must point at a manager and `driver` must name an installed CSI plugin. Changing anything except `availability` forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec))
- `driver` (String) Volume driver. Default `local`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `driver_opts` (Map of String) Driver options, e.g. `{ type = "nfs", o = "addr=10.0.0.1,rw", device = ":/export" }` for `local`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `labels` (Map of String) Volume labels. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Volume name. Unset lets the daemon generate one. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_volume_id` (String) Swarm object ID of a cluster volume (`ClusterVolume.ID`); null for a local volume.
- `config_sha256` (String) SHA-256 (hex) of the configuration part of inspect_json only (Name, Driver, Scope, Labels, Options and ClusterVolume.Spec; never State, timestamps, PIDs, health logs or daemon-assigned addresses), as canonical JSON. Stable across reads of an unchanged object; the hash a downstream consumer should watch.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 (hex) of inspect_json, the raw Engine response: it changes whenever runtime state changes (State, health log, timestamps, PIDs, daemon-assigned addresses), not only the configuration. Watch config_sha256 to react to configuration changes.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `id` (String) Volume name (volumes have no separate ID).
- `inspect` (Attributes) The GET /volumes/{name} response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inspect))
- `inspect_json` (String, Sensitive) The exact Engine API GET /volumes/{name} response as JSON.
- `mountpoint` (String) Host path of the volume's data, as reported by the driver.

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_volume_spec`

Optional:

- `access_mode` (Attributes) How the volume may be used by tasks (`AccessMode`). Forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--access_mode))
- `accessibility_requirements` (Attributes) Topology constraints on where the volume is created (`AccessibilityRequirements`). Forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--accessibility_requirements))
- `availability` (String) Scheduling availability: `active`, `pause` or `drain` (default `active`). Updated in place with `VolumeUpdate`.
- `capacity_range` (Attributes) Size bounds passed to the CSI plugin (`CapacityRange`). Forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--capacity_range))
- `group` (String) Volume group; services can request any volume of a group (`group:<name>`). Forces replacement.
- `secrets` (Attributes List) Swarm secrets passed to the CSI plugin. Forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--secrets))

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--access_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_volume_spec.access_mode`

Optional:

- `block_volume` (Boolean) Use the volume as a raw block device (`BlockVolume`) instead of a mount. Forces replacement.
- `mount_volume` (Attributes) Use the volume as a mounted filesystem (`MountVolume`). Forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--access_mode--mount_volume))
- `scope` (String) `single` (one node at a time) or `multi` (several nodes). Forces replacement.
- `sharing` (String) Sharing between tasks: `none`, `readonly`, `onewriter` or `all`. Forces replacement.

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--access_mode--mount_volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_volume_spec.access_mode.mount_volume`

Optional:

- `fs_type` (String) Filesystem type, e.g. `ext4`. Forces replacement.
- `mount_flags` (List of String) Mount flags. Forces replacement.



<a id="nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--accessibility_requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_volume_spec.accessibility_requirements`

Optional:

- `preferred` (List of Map of String) Topologies (segment maps) preferred for the volume, in order. Forces replacement.
- `requisite` (List of Map of String) Topologies (segment maps) the volume must be accessible from. Forces replacement.


<a id="nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--capacity_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_volume_spec.capacity_range`

Optional:

- `limit_bytes` (Number) Maximum size in bytes. Forces replacement.
- `required_bytes` (Number) Minimum size in bytes. Forces replacement.


<a id="nestedatt--cluster_volume_spec--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_volume_spec.secrets`

Required:

- `key` (String) Key the plugin receives the secret under. Forces replacement.
- `secret` (String) Name or ID of the Swarm secret. Forces replacement.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by volume name.
terraform import docker_volume.data app-data
```
